system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.
region_name: Huron Creek watershed, Michigan, United States
task_description: You are an agent exploring a small watershed using metre-scale lidar-derived bare-earth elevation. Examine micro-topography, drainage structure and terrain-resolution effects that are visible only in fine elevation data.

spatial_coverage.region_name: Huron Creek watershed, Michigan, United States
spatial_coverage.coverage: Small Huron Creek watershed in Houghton County, Michigan Upper Peninsula, roughly 7.25 km2 with a main channel about 5.15 km long. The region is retained as the executable USGS 3DEP benchmark area after seed replacement because the replacement seed's Portuguese UAV-lidar survey is not available through the US-only catalog Anchor.

data_description.temporal_unit: Static per acquisition project; tiles are not necessarily seamless across projects
analytical_capabilities: Metre-scale bare-earth elevation and micro-topographic structure analysis
Slope, aspect, curvature, relief and terrace-geometry derivation
Drainage-network extraction and flow-routing sensitivity analysis
Resolution aggregation experiments from a qualifying one-metre lidar source
Terrain input for fine-resolution hydrological modelling

unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the `elevation` band in metres. Mosaic only tiles from a documented acquisition project, inspect seams, and verify coverage before analysis. Any coarser experimental grid must be derived from the qualifying one-metre source.

data_description.data_source: USGS 3D Elevation Program, produced exclusively from high-resolution airborne lidar
data_description.region_scope_provenance: Executable region retained from the former seed 10.1007/s12145-023-01218-x because it is within USGS 3DEP coverage; replacement seed 10.3390/rs15010169 supplies the earlier multi-dataset scientific design but its Portuguese project lidar is not the runtime asset.
data_description.asset_provenance: The replacement seed constructs 0.1-1 m bare-earth DEMs from project UAV lidar. USGS/3DEP/1m is the ready catalog analogue for the same physical object and measurement semantics. Seed-study geography is not claimed as runtime coverage.
